simple.meaning: סַעַר (çaʻar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a hurricane.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 26 times across 2 Kings, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 4 more, beginning at 2 Kings 2:1. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סַעַר (H5591).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: סַעַר (çaʻar) / H5591 is traced through 2 Kings 2:1, 2 Kings 2:11, Job 38:1, Job 40:6 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H5591. ca 'ar סַ֫עַר noun masculine Jer 23:19 tempest ; — absolute ׳ס Amos 1:14 5 t.; סָ֑עַר Psa 55:9 ; plural suffix סַעֲרֶיךָ 83:16 ; — tempest , especially figurative: of passionate acts ofmen, מִסָּ֑עַר סֹעָה מֵרוּחַ 55:9 ( ׳מִסּ here awkward, without ו ); of ׳י s wrath Jer 23:19 ( ׳ס מִתְחוֺלֵל ), compare 25:32 ; 30:23 ; tempest as instrument of ׳י s wrath, Psa 83:16 (|| סוּפָה ); see also סוּפָה בְּיוֺם בְּסַעַר Amos 1:14 and Joel 1:4 , 12 . סְעָרָה noun feminine tempest, storm-wind ; — absolute סְעָרָה Isa 29:6 + (so also 2Kin 2:1 , 11 Ginsb; Baer בַּסֳּעָרָה ); construct סַעֲרַת Jer 23:19 ; 30:23 ; plural סְעָרוֺת Ezek 13:11 , 13 construct סַעֲרוֺת Zech 9:14 ; — tempest, storm-wind , as instrument of ׳י s wrath, Isa 29:6 (+ סוּפָה ), compare 40:24 ; 41:16 , also סְעָרוֺת רוּחַ Ezek 13:11 , 13 (against nation under figure of wall); storm-wind of Elijah's translation 2Kin 2:1 , 11 ; of theophany Ezek 1:4 ( סְעָרָה רוּחַ ), Job 38:1 ; 40:6 , and תֵּימָן סַעֲרוֺת Zech 9:14 ; י ׳סַעֲרַת as figurative of ׳י s wrath Jer 23:19 ; 30:23 ; of ordinary tempests only in late Psalms: סְעָרָה רוּחַ Jer 107:25; Jer 148:8, ׳ס opposed to דְּמָמָה Jer 107:29. I, II, III. סַף see ספף . ספא (√ of following; compare Late Hebrew ספי סָפָא, give to eat , סְפִי ᵑ7 id. ; perhaps Palmyrene ספא feed, nourish , Lzb 330 Cook 85 ). II. שַׂ֫עַר noun [masculine] storm (= סַ֫עַר ); — only construct ׳שׂ קָ֑טֶב Isa 28:2 a storm of destruction (in simile; || בָּרָד זֶרֶם ). שְׂעָרָה noun feminine id. (= סְעָרָה ); — of way of וּבִשׂ ׳בְּסוּפָה ׳י Nahum 1:3 ; figurative of ׳י s judgments; ׳אֲשֶׁרבִּֿשׂ יְשׁוּפֵנִי Job 9:17 .
